typography: Preserve the existing typography system (Plus Jakarta Sans) used in modern.css and kanban.css. Stick to standard SaaS legibility. Use 14px base size for kanban items (.ck-text) and 12px-13px for labels (.ck-muted). Do not introduce any generic default fonts for headings if not already in the project. Maintain the existing font hierarchy.
colors: Strictly follow the variables in kanban.css: --ck-brand (#2c63e8), --ck-text (#1f2a44), --ck-muted (#6b7690), --ck-line (#e4e8f0), and --ck-surface (#f6f7fb). Use existing status/priority colors (e.g., #10b981 for done/success, #e5484d for danger/red, #f59e0b for amber). Avoid adding new palettes. Maintain the existing light blue-and-white CSS system. Never use pure black/white for text without proper contrast consideration.
visual enhancers: Leverage existing lightweight visual enhancers: 8px to 12px border radii, 1px solid borders using --ck-line, and soft box-shadows (e.g., box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -14px #0f1f4a55). For new popovers, overlays, or interactive elements (like the Whiteboard toolbar), use solid #fff backgrounds with --ck-line border.
component name: SpaceSidebar, GanttChart, WorkloadView, Whiteboard, SprintPlanner, GoalTracker, AutomationRules, RichTextDoc, NotificationBell
grids: Use CSS Grid (display: grid) for Timeline/Gantt chart, Workload grid, and Dashboard widgets. Preserve existing Flexbox (.ck-board, .ck-col) layouts for boards and lists.
layouts: Incremental organization plan: Do not cram into one page. Expand ProjectDetail.jsx tabs to include: Kanban (enhanced with left Space/Folder/List sidebar), Timeline (Gantt), Dokumen (shared rich text), Whiteboard, Sprints, Goals, Kapasitas Tim (Workload), Automasi (Automations), and Dashboard Lanjutan. Ensure each major feature operates in its own project route/tab. For TaskDetail.jsx, add custom fields, task templates, milestone flags, recurring tasks, and mentions/assigned comments natively into the drawer layout.
motion: Use existing lightweight CSS animations (ck-slide, ck-fade, ck-up) from kanban.css. Ensure hover states on new buttons utilize `transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s`. Avoid heavy JS animation libraries.
accessibility: Critical: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, task cards, filter dropdowns, timeline bars, whiteboard tools, and automation triggers) MUST have a descriptive `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="add-folder-btn"`). Ensure focus states maintain contrast.
media: Use lucide-react icons exclusively (e.g., Folder, Milestone, Bell, Zap, Repeat). No external images or placeholders required.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Add specific transitions for interactive elements. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Ensure all modal overlays and dropdowns do not have completely transparent backgrounds; use solid backgrounds or backdrop filters to preserve text readability. All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. Do not inject 'AI slop' gradients.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Maintain the existing 'ClickUp-like' SaaS aesthetic (.ck- classes). Prioritize information density while ensuring click targets are at least 32px-38px tall. Use optical alignment for icons within buttons. Highlight active states clearly (e.g., `.ck-view-btn.active`). Maintain consistent 12px-16px padding inside panel components. Keep the interface clean, functional, and highly legible. Ensure new project tabs maintain the same layout structure as existing ones.
